planting.note: Plant container shrubs in spring or fall in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade; Miranda holds the Royal Horticultural Society's Award of Garden Merit as a reliable garden selection of mountain hydrangea.

directions: Grow in moist, humus-rich, well-drained soil in partial shade, with protection from strong midday sun and drying wind. Like other mountain hydrangeas, Miranda carries flattened lacecap flowerheads whose outer sepals shift in color with soil pH, and it is generally more sun-tolerant and cold-hardy than bigleaf hydrangea. It has earned the RHS Award of Garden Merit as a dependable garden plant. Water deeply during dry spells and mulch to keep roots cool through summer heat.
